name: devops-assistant
description: GitOps-first Kubernetes operations for Claude: Argo CD/Workflows, Helm, Kustomize, RCA, validation and security gates, with a hard lock on destructive actions and zero credential exposure.

steveVoice.title: Steve's voice
steveVoice.description: The macOS voice Steve speaks with when ♪ voice is on in the k8s pane. auto picks the most natural English voice installed: one marked (Premium), then (Enhanced), else Rocko. Download more natural voices in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System voice → Manage Voices. A voice that is not installed falls back to the system default.

steveEngine.title: Steve's speech engine
steveEngine.description: piper: a local neural voice (much less robotic; needs piper and a voice model, see stevePiperVoice). say: the macOS voices. auto: piper when it and its voice are installed, else say. Both run on this machine.

stevePiperVoice.title: Steve's Piper voice
stevePiperVoice.description: A Piper voice name in ~/.local/share/piper-voices (download with: python -m piper.download_voices --download-dir ~/.local/share/piper-voices en_US-ryan-medium), or a full path to an .onnx model.

steveMicrophone.title: Steve's microphone
steveMicrophone.description: The microphone 🎤 talk records from: default, or an input device's name or index as `ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""` lists them.

steveWhisperModel.title: Whisper model
steveWhisperModel.description: The whisper.cpp model 🎤 talk transcribes with, on this machine. ggml-base.en.bin is fast and good for English.

steveHearingSends.title: Send what Steve hears
steveHearingSends.description: Off: what you say goes into the prompt box for you to check and send. On: it is sent at once.

steveSwearing.title: Steve swears
steveSwearing.description: Steve is a grumpy DevOps engineer either way. On, he uses mild bad words about the code and the situation (crap, damn, hell). Off, he stays grumpy but clean.
